## About this item

Hey students and note-takers! This adorable Yoobi 3-pack of spiral notebooks is exactly what you need to stay organized in style. Each notebook features super cute designs - think colorful sprinkles, sweet marshmallow animals, and dreamy pastel patterns that make actually wanting to take notes way easier. But they're not just pretty faces - each notebook has 100 wide-ruled pages that are perforated for clean tearing and 3-hole punched so they fit perfectly in your binders. The inside pocket is genius for storing loose papers, permission slips, or those random notes you're always losing. What's really cool about Yoobi is that when you buy these, they donate school supplies to kids in need through the Kids In Need Foundation. So you're not just getting awesome notebooks - you're helping other students get the supplies they need too. Perfect for elementary school, middle school, or even just for journaling and list-making at home. The 8x10.5 inch size is ideal for backpacks, and the sturdy spiral binding holds up through a whole school year of rough handling. Seriously, if you're tired of boring notebooks and want something that actually makes you excited to write stuff down, this 3-pack is totally worth it.
